Kimberly / team — draft language below. Kept it tight to avoid back-and-forth. Olga, shout if Legal wants stricter terms.

PROPOSED REDLINE (for Section X - Publicity and Section Y - Confidentiality):

"Publicity and Joint Announcements: Neither party will issue any press release or public announcement regarding the relationship, the existence of this Agreement, or the other party's Confidential Information without the prior written consent of the other party, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, either party may request an embargo period of up to thirty (30) days following completion of mutually agreed milestones. The requesting party must notify the other party in writing and provide draft materials; the other party shall provide approval or material comments within seven (7) business days.

Logo Usage and Attribution: Customer grants Redwood a non-exclusive, revocable right to display Customer's name and logo on Redwood's website and marketing materials for the duration of this Agreement, subject to Customer's brand guidelines and prior written approval of final co-branded materials. Redwood will submit final co-branded assets for approval and Customer will use reasonable efforts to review and approve or request edits within seven (7) business days.

Confidentiality Carve-out for Reference Use: Notwithstanding the confidentiality obligations herein, Redwood may identify Customer as a Redwood customer in sales lists and short-form marketing collateral (e.g., website customer lists, case study titles) without disclosing Confidential Information. Any detailed case study or testimonial that references Customer data or Confidential Information will require prior written approval from Customer."

I removed language that automatically allows us to publish after a short notice — instead we rely on "not unreasonably withheld" plus a defined review window. That should help Procurement move faster.

If everyone signs off, I can send the redline back to Sara with the edited docx and a proposed Docusign envelope (Marissa — I'll coordinate the envelope contents).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
